title: CustomerRecord
description: Everything collected for one request: the customer's identity, from the customer directory, their accounts, and one slot per source. The root of the collected payload.

customerId.description: The customer's identifier, the same in every upstream system.

name.description: The customer's full name, as they gave it.

displayName.description: The name the customer goes by, when it isn't their full name.

segment.description: Which part of the bank serves the customer.

residenceCountry.description: Country the customer lives in (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

phone.description: The customer's phone number, in E.164 (+441632960123).

contactPreference.description: What the customer API holds on how the customer wants to be contacted.

accounts.description: The customer's accounts; none when they hold none.
